title: Gen 6 Formula Pro Tubeless Ready S-Light
notes: Official US page read 2026-11-01: sixth-generation lightweight tubeless-ready race tire with a dual compound and RBCC2 tread; requires tubeless-ready rims, valves and sealant. Table (IRC no. 190709-190716, two colourways): 700x25C 220 g, 65-110 psi hooked / 65-73 psi hookless; 28C 255 g, 65-94 / 65-73; 30C 275 g, 60-80 / 60-73; 32C 300 g, 50-73 / 50-73; folding bead. No price; IRC says to buy from local bike shops or the Pure Gravel web store.
